QF.id: Registration, Code of Conduct and General Obligations_70

question.text: What is the Online Document Repository maintained by stock exchanges used for?

answer.text: Filing annual returns of merchant bankers with SEBI
Uploading and maintaining, electronically, the documents relied on by merchant bankers while conducting due diligence in public issues, for easier access
Publishing research reports for public consumption
Recording trading data of merchant banker proprietary desks

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook describes the Online Document Repository as a stock-exchange platform for uploading and maintaining, in electronic form, the documents relied on by merchant bankers while conducting due diligence in public issues, so that those documents are available for easier access. The Trap: It is tempting to overgeneralize this to "all books and records of merchant bankers", but the repository is specifically scoped to due-diligence documents relied on in public issues — not the full books-and-records universe. Note: Annual returns, research reports, and proprietary-desk trading data are governed by separate reporting/filing channels and are not the purpose of this repository.
